fields.description: Address Villas – Tierra is a collection of four to six bedroom detached villas within The Oasis. Its waterfront setting combines canals, landscaped spaces and shared leisure facilities with Address branding. The homes pair glass, stone, steel and wood with open interiors; layouts vary from three-level five bedroom homes to larger basement configurations.

overview: The neighbourhood is arranged around water and landscaped outdoor spaces. Its brochure brings together a clubhouse, lagoon, Spring Garden, Water Stream Park and multipurpose hall. Inside the homes, natural materials and neutral finishes complement open living areas. Address branding describes the development; a buyer should confirm the actual service package and charges rather than assume that hotel services are included.
research.locationNote: Tierra is within The Oasis, southeast of central Dubai according to Emaar’s brochure. The community map shows the surrounding highway network and wider links to Dubai Marina, Dubai Hills and Al Maktoum International Airport. A selected plot and current access route should be checked separately.
research.priceNote: The official project page advertises homes from AED 13.16 million. The launch fact sheet quoted AED 13.16 million for four bedrooms, AED 13.86 million for five and AED 24.4 million for six. Current unit availability and pricing require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The published launch schedule allocates 10% at booking, 70% across seven instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Dates below are historical launch terms, including amounts that would already have fallen due. They do not replace a current offer or contract.
research.handoverNote: The copied launch fact sheet targets June 2029 for estimated construction completion. Property Finder reports the same month. Current progress and the contractual handover date remain to be confirmed.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The fact sheet describes 487 detached villas: 178 four bedroom, 260 five bedroom and 49 six bedroom homes. These are release totals, not available stock.

facts.label: Average plot sizes
facts.value: Four bedroom plots average 9,174 sq ft, five bedroom plots 11,254 sq ft and six bedroom plots 16,746 sq ft in the launch sheet. Each selected plot needs its own measurement check.

facts.label: Comparing villa layouts
facts.value: Plan totals include terraces/balconies and carports. Four bedroom types have basements; five bedroom options have either three levels or a basement plus roof level. Six bedroom layouts include basement and roof levels.
